# Noto Sans (web-script fallback faces)

Noto Sans Arabic / Hebrew / Thai / Devanagari (notofonts.github.io, hinted TTF, whole) and `NotoSansCJKsc-Subset.otf`
(Noto Sans CJK SC cut down to GB2312 + JIS X 0208 + Big5 level 1 + KS X 1001 hangul + CJK/fullwidth punctuation, 14043
glyphs, by `tools/font_web_gen.py`). All SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`); the subset keeps the font names and
copyright records. Used by the BrowserNG engine's glyph fallback (Resource\Fonts\web\ in the ROM).
